Meguri bundles the stock tex-svg engine, assistive MathML, mhchem and its
SVG font extension, and the New Computer Modern dynamic SVG glyph files.
The TeX configuration enables base, AMS and mhchem, with require/autoload
restricted to supported packages. Other packages compiled into tex-svg are
disabled; their standalone components and optional font extensions are not
shipped. All retained upstream engine, component and font files are unmodified.
